data.title: 60km of Summer Freedom – No Charging, Just Riding
data.body: Summer's here, and your weekend just got a serious upgrade. 🛴 The iENYRID ES1 gives you up to 60km of range—enough to explore the city, hit the coast, or cruise to brunch without hunting for a plug. Its 2400W motor tackles 30° hills like they're flat. Lightweight, foldable, and with dual disc brakes for peace of mind. Grab yours now at iENYRID!
